build.buildCommand: cd shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && ls -la dist/ && find dist -name 'main.js' -o -name 'main.js.map' 2>/dev/null || echo 'No dist/main.js found'

deploy.startCommand: cd backend && (ls -la dist/ || echo 'dist not found') && (find . -name 'main.js' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'main.js not found') && node dist/main.js
